examples.english: I asked the waiter, "How much is this juice?"
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt el garson bekam el 'aseer da.
examples.storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

examples.english: I am waiting for the waiter to come.
The waiter came and asked "What do you want?".
examples.transliteration: El garsoon geh w sa'al 'ayez eh.

examples.arabic: سلمت على الجرسون وقلت صباح الخير
examples.english: I greeted the waiter and said good morning
examples.transliteration: Sallamt ala el-garsoon we olt sabah el-kheer

examples.arabic: لما لقيت ترابيزة فاضية قعدت استنى الجرسون يجي ياخد الطلب
examples.english: When I found an empty table, I sat waiting for the waiter to come take the order.
examples.transliteration: Lamma la'eet tarabeeza fadya qa'adt astanna el-garson yigi yakhod et-talab

examples.english: The waiter came and said 'What do you want?'
examples.transliteration: El garsoon geh we aal 'Ayiz eh?'
